text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Download(x, y) ::: y downloads x.
Share(x, y) ::: x shares y with y.
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Karen(y) ::: y is Karen.
BlackMirror(x) ::: x is "Black Mirror".
Question:  
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Karen will share "Black Mirror" with Lisa.

Premises:
∀x (NetflixShow(x) ∧ Popular(x) → BingeWatch(x, Karen)) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Download(x, Karen)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download("Black Mirror", Karen) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
NetflixShow("Black Mirror") ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Share(x, Lisa)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it with Lisa.

Conclusion:
Share("Black Mirror", Lisa)
